pairs.jd_posting_title: Elixir / Phoenix developer for meaningful product
pairs.jd_description: **Company / Mission** Most retailers don’t know what to do with returned and unsold items, they lack technologies and efficient systems. Eventually a huge amount of goods is sent to the landfill. Our solution allows to take unsold and returned goods from retailers’ warehouses, process and analyze each item and choose the right market and channel to remarket it, thus reducing waste and making quality overstock and returned items available to new consumers. **Technology** - Backend systems currently use Elixir and Phoenix, as well as Postgres, Redis and RabbitMQ (AMQP) for integrations with in-warehouse systems and 3rd party warehouse vendors, and are currently hosted on Heroku. - On-site/in-warehouse system responsible for supporting warehouse operations, capable of working even without internet. Here Elixir’s Nerves project is used to package the server and stationary workstations into burnable firmware running on Raspberry Pi 4s. In-warehouse server consists of a Regular Phoenix app packaged into Nerves firmware. - Just FYI: Frontend apps are being built with Ember.js (Octane). Auth0 is used for authentication, authorization, user management. UI clients are hosted on Amazon S3. **Team** - Currently 4 people in Berlin - Very soon: You, in Ukraine:) - Then: 3-4 more developers also in Ukraine **About you** - You have been building software for at least 3 years, incl. with Elixir and Phoenix - You write code for human comprehension first, then for machines to execute fast - If you’re stuck, you have no fear of asking questions - You have good verbal and written communication skills in English - You have some idea about the Elixir Nerves project, and are eager to experiment with it - You understand the DevOps principles (Ideally you have read the DevOps Handbook or something similar) **Model** - Dedicated product team (some call it outstaffing) - work like one team with the CTO in Berlin - No walls, no project managers in between - Travel to Berlin from time to time **Offer** - Very competitive salary (can be paid to Payoneer if you want) - Flexible hours; No bureaucracy; Freedom to do your work right - Remote OK! - If you're in Lviv or want to move here - we have modern office in city center - 20 days per year paid vacation, paid sick leaves

We are looking for both middle and senior-level specialists. **Bunch Consulting** is an international outsourcing IT company focused on software development and business digital transformation consulting. Headquarter is located in Warsaw, Poland, and the main office is based in Kyiv, Ukraine. **Requirements**: - Hands-on development experience with Kafka, Confluent Kafka Connect, and Kafka Streams. - Experience and interest of Kafka Developer - producers, consumers, streams, preferred connectors knowledge, preferred KSQL knowledge, schema registry, and confluent experience /knowledge preferred. - Experience with Confluent Kafka API lifecycle development and management. - Experience in CI/CD Deployment procedures and DevOps. - An understanding as well as further curiosity about ensuring that unit, system, integration, stress, and user acceptance testing are in alignment with architecture. - Fluent English. - Desire to develop and challenge himself while working on a project. Outstanding communication skills **We offer you**: - Continuous growth and development as a professional in terms of Seniority and Tech Leadership in a fast-growing company. - The decent salary level and revisions depend on your growth in the company and your desires. - Comfortable working conditions on a remote basis. - A motivated team. - Improvement of your spoken English. - To be surrounded by people who love what they do and be in the continuous development of new technologies. **Working conditions**: Full time. Remote. **Project duration**: 6-12 months, with further prolongation.

Create a policy specification like a recommendation, audit and remediation procedures. Build and Create auto remediation framework and scripts for the specific service or policy. A technical interview with Engineering Leader (60 mins). A interview with VP of R&D (60 mins). Final feedback received within a week after the interview.
